meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会先分清请求类型(提交、改写历史、查历史、看状态),先读仓库状态再动手:要么把改动按行为拆成原子提交,要么用具体命令证据回答某处改动出自哪个提交。
howto.when: 当你要求提交代码、改写分支历史,或调查某个文件/某几行由哪个提交改的时接管;普通代码编辑不接管。

say.text: 把当前改动按功能拆成几个原子提交
say.note: 先看 diff 再分组暂存提交

say.text: 查一下 README 这段文字是哪次提交改的
say.note: 用 git log -S 等给出提交哈希

say.text: 把这个 fixup 提交合并进目标提交

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude classifies each git request (commit, rebase, history, status), reads the repo state first, then stages atomic commits by behavior or answers history questions with exact command evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to commit changes, rewrite branch history, or investigate which commit changed a file or line; it skips ordinary code edits.

say_en.text: Split these changes into a few atomic commits by feature.
say_en.note: It reads the diff, groups, stages, commits

say_en.text: Which commit changed this paragraph in the README?
say_en.note: Uses git log -S and cites the hash

say_en.text: Squash this fixup commit into the target one.
